change: CheckpointReadiness.cancel withdraws only the matching owner's local preparation receipt
coverage: Cancellation immediately invalidates an already staged local receipt, including a later common start permit.
The previous policy and immutable archive remain unchanged; no additional import, native load or mount call is issued.
An old owner cannot withdraw a replacement preparation of the same archive.
A missing receipt is not recreated, repeated cancellation is harmless and cancelled owners cannot refresh.
limits: The local preparation worker must serialize cancel with refresh; concurrent lock acquisition can fail.
No automatic lobby/controller/UI cancellation path is connected by this change.
Cancellation does not stop a native load that has already begun or revoke its mount.
Native and Lua byte equality does not prove E3 of this new Python cancellation method.
The prior positive local E3 load remains assigned to source commit 17d862e55e2badbe515a8086593fb61ab8a7530e.
Shared controller/capability/archive-transfer contract and E4 remain pending.
